provenance.measurement_scope: Mac/Metal raw-completion accuracy only; no Mac throughput or memory is substituted into GCP scoring.

policy: Grade the entire raw /completion output, including planning text and literal thinking tags. These are not chat final-answer-only grades.

strict_pass requires the correct unambiguous answer and every explicitly requested substantive calculation, explanation, comparison and check. A check may be a genuine distinct numerical method; repeating the same derivation or saying confirmed is insufficient.
core_answer_correct records the main requested result separately from missing or faulty support. Isolated correct numbers in option lists and unresolved contradictory answers do not qualify.
A uniquely correct option value with working may pass without the letter, flagged accordingly. An explicitly wrong option letter fails strict_pass even if the value is correct.

Clear self-corrections are accepted. Unresolved material scientific or mathematical errors and unsafe additional advice fail strict_pass. Weak or imprecise supplementary wording alone is not automatically a factual-error veto.
Word-count, sentence-count, repetition and token-cap deviations alone do not fail an otherwise complete and correct response.
Every response was read in full; no semantic decision was transferred from another source or another hardware treatment.
This is provisional assistant grading of an internal STEM battery, not an official ADTC panel score, ARC accuracy or composite competition score.

reuse_audit.note: All 100 complete raw outputs were read directly; no prior semantic decisions were reused.

original_option_parser.meaning: Saved option-parser marks are diagnostic only, not the manual score.

review_status: all 100 manually adjudicated; lead resolved S13 as a strict pass

independent_review.result: Earlier reviewer covered five listed cases. Additional full-response cross-review of 22 selected cases verified source bindings and challenged S13's strict failure. Lead adjudication changed S13 to pass; other reviewed decisions retained.
independent_review.limitation: Source-binding verification of all 100 and selected full-response cross-review, not a second full semantic regrade of all 100.
